candidate.answerReason: The elements of \(A\) split into those shared with \(B\) and those outside \(B\). The latter number is \(6-2=4\).

methods.label: Remove the shared elements
methods.explanation: Remove the 2 common elements from \(A\). The remaining 4 elements belong only to \(A\).
methods.levelReason: Uses elementary subtraction after identifying the common elements.
